requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed frontend data schema for PI credibility including fields: investigator_name, institution, prior_trial_count, publication_indicator, and score_contribution.
The system must ensure investigator_name is a non-empty string when provided in the schema.
The system must define institution as a nullable string field in the schema.
The system must define prior_trial_count as a non-negative integer.
The system must define publication_indicator as a boolean field representing presence of publications.
The system must define score_contribution as a numeric field representing PI contribution to overall trial score.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with MessageBubble.tsx rendering input format.
The system must accept partial PI data objects where one or more optional fields are null without schema validation failure.
The system must reject PI data objects missing required fields investigator_name or score_contribution.
The system must align field names and types with the backend contract provided by EVAL-CT-MEASURE-PI.
The system must define a consistent JSON serialization format for PI credibility data used in chat responses.
The system must ensure the schema supports rendering multiple PI entries in a list structure.
The system must ensure numeric fields are safely parseable by the frontend without runtime type coercion errors.
The system must ensure the schema can be extended with additional PI attributes without breaking backward compatibility.
The system must ensure LLM-generated responses include PI credibility data structured exactly according to the defined schema.
The system must ensure the LLM does not hallucinate fields outside the defined PI schema.
The system must ensure the LLM populates publication_indicator strictly as true or false, not string equivalents.
The system must ensure the LLM outputs prior_trial_count as an integer value.
The system must ensure the LLM includes score_contribution when PI data is present.
The system must ensure the LLM omits PI credibility block entirely when no PI data is available.
